title: Oka classification for minimal compact complex surfaces: Kodaira dimension zero and class VII

result.label: Oka classification for minimal compact complex surfaces: Kodaira dimension zero and class VII
result.statement: Proves that every complex K3 surface is Oka, including nonprojective surfaces. More generally, every connected minimal compact complex surface of Kodaira dimension zero is Oka; a connected minimal compact complex surface of class VII is Oka exactly when it is a Hopf or Enoki surface.
